# 01 Freeze sequence-diagram contracts and parse core syntax (participants, all 10 arrows, title, autonumber)

## Outcome

`packages/core/src/contracts.ts` exports the full sequence-diagram type surface for the entire
board (including block/create/destroy/box shapes not implemented until later tickets), and
`SirenDocument` becomes a `kind`-discriminated union. `parseSiren(source)` keeps its exact public
signature but dispatches on the first non-blank line to `parseFlowchart` (existing logic,
extracted verbatim, zero behavior change) or `parseSequenceDiagram` (new). `parseSequenceDiagram`
recognizes `sequenceDiagram`, `participant`/`actor` declarations (with `as` aliasing), all ten
message arrow forms, `title`, and `autonumber`/`autonumber off`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `pnpm --filter @siren/core test` still passes with zero changes to existing flowchart test
  files — the extraction of `parseFlowchart` is behavior-preserving.
- [ ] `parseSiren` on a `flowchart TD` document returns the same `SirenDocument` shape as before,
  now tagged `kind: "flowchart"`.
- [ ] `parseSiren` on:
  ```
  sequenceDiagram
    title Order confirmation flow
    participant A as Alice
    actor B as Bob
    A->>B: Sync call
    A-->>B: Dotted no arrow
    A->>+B: (activation shorthand is NOT parsed specially — treat literally, see note below)
  ```
  correctly parses `title`, both declaration forms, and routes to `parseSequenceDiagram`
  returning `kind: "sequence"`. (Activation shorthand `+`/`-` is out of scope per the spec's
  non-goals — a message using it should either be rejected with a diagnostic or have the
  `+`/`-` ignored as literal syntax noise; pick one and document it in this ticket's
  implementation, since the spec does not pin this down.)
- [ ] `parseSequenceDiagram` on a document exercising all ten arrow forms (`->`, `-->`, `->>`,
  `-->>`, `<<->>`, `<<-->>`, `-x`, `--x`, `-)`, `--)`) between two declared participants produces
  ten `message` statements with the correct `{ line, head }` per the spec's Domain decisions.
- [ ] `A->>A: self` (undeclared-but-self target) parses as a self-message between the same
  participant id.
- [ ] A message referencing a participant id with no prior `participant`/`actor` declaration is
  *not* rejected at parse time (that's `buildSequenceModel`'s job in ticket 02) — the parser
  only validates syntax shape, not reference validity.
- [ ] `autonumber` and `autonumber off` each parse to their own statement kind, at whatever
  position they appear in the statement stream.
- [ ] Malformed input (unrecognized statement line, missing `end` — not applicable yet since no
  blocks exist this ticket, unterminated `sequenceDiagram` with no body) returns `document: null`
  plus at least one error diagnostic; never throws.
- [ ] `contracts.ts` exports `SequenceDocument`, `SequenceParticipantDecl`, `SequenceBox`,
  `SequenceStatement` (recursive union covering all leaf and block kinds from the spec, even
  though only `message`/`participant`/`destroy`/`autonumberOn`/`autonumberOff` are produced by
  this ticket's parser), `SequenceArrowLine`, `SequenceArrowHead`, `SequenceModel`,
  `PositionedSequenceDiagram` and its constituent `Positioned*` types, matching the spec's Design
  Contract section.

## Test seam

`parseSiren(source: string): ParseResult` (dispatch, both diagram kinds) and
`parseSequenceDiagram(source: string): ParseResult` (direct) — both unit level, pure functions,
no DOM/environment dependency.
